verdict: Organic signals are fading across all three entities; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, all measurable activity this period came exclusively from Google Business Profile and organic search — combined, your three entities recorded 395 GBP actions, 6 calls, 279 direction requests, and 110 web clicks over the last 28 days, with zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. Organic momentum softened into the final days of the period: GBP actions fell 50%, 21%, and 21% week-over-week for Forte, AGS, and O'Hare respectively, and Search Console clicks declined across all three, with O'Hare down 36% in the most recent week. The root-cause SEO fix and CRM stub reconciliation — both originally due August 31 — are the primary blockers holding back visibility recovery and outreach sequencing; resolving the 342 unreconciled accounts is the immediate priority so customer data can flow and lapsed outreach sequences can launch. Once the SEO fix is submitted and the CRM is unblocked, impression and click recovery is expected to follow by the end of October.
